title: Add missing unit tests
prompt: `src/strings.ts` exports three helpers but has no tests. Create `test/strings.test.mjs` that exercises `slugify`, `truncate` and `titleCase` with real assertions and exits non-zero on any failure. It must import the helpers from `../src/strings.ts` and run under `node test/strings.test.mjs`. Do not change `src/strings.ts`.
